findings.title: Invalid JSON-LD syntax detected
findings.evidence: 2 page(s) have JSON-LD blocks that fail JSON parsing: https://www.boat-lifestyle.com/products/nirvana-uno; https://www.boat-lifestyle.com/products/stone-grenade

suggested_action.summary: Fix JSON syntax errors in application/ld+json script blocks. Validate with Google Rich Results Test.
Standardise address formatting across all pages and JSON-LD. Use PostalAddress structured data with consistent field values.

findings.title: Organization schema missing disambiguation properties
findings.evidence: Primary Organization block is missing: foundingDate, address, knowsAbout, legalName

suggested_action.summary: Add foundingDate, address, legalName, and knowsAbout to your Organization JSON-LD to help AI engines distinguish your brand from others with similar names.

findings.title: Pages with stale content metadata
findings.evidence: 3 page(s) have content dated older than 365 days: https://www.boat-lifestyle.com/products/nirvana-uno; https://www.boat-lifestyle.com/products/stone-grenade; https://www.boat-lifestyle.com/products/stone-200-bluetooth-speaker

suggested_action.summary: Update content freshness signals (dateModified in JSON-LD, Last-Modified header, or meta tags) when content is revised.

findings.title: Multiple H1 tags on a single page

suggested_action.summary: Use a single <h1> per page. Use <h2>-<h6> for sub-sections to maintain a clear heading hierarchy.

findings.title: Newsletter subscription modal detected
findings.evidence: 4 page(s) have newsletter/subscribe modal elements: https://www.boat-lifestyle.com/; https://www.boat-lifestyle.com/products/nirvana-uno; https://www.boat-lifestyle.com/products/stone-grenade; https://www.boat-lifestyle.com/products/stone-200-bluetooth-speaker

suggested_action.summary: Delay newsletter modals until after meaningful user interaction. Avoid showing them to crawler user-agents.

findings.title: No RSS or Atom feed detected
findings.evidence: No <link rel='alternate'> with type application/rss+xml or application/atom+xml was found across any crawled page.

suggested_action.summary: Publish an RSS or Atom feed for your blog, news, or product updates. Syndication feeds enable AI aggregators and citation engines to track your content freshness automatically.

findings.title: No explicit Allow directive for AI crawlers in robots.txt
findings.evidence: robots.txt does not contain any explicit Allow: directive under an AI-crawler User-agent section (e.g. GPTBot, Google-Extended). While absence of Disallow may suffice, explicit Allow signals welcoming intent.

suggested_action.summary: Add explicit User-agent/Allow blocks for key AI crawlers (GPTBot, Google-Extended, anthropic-ai) in robots.txt to signal that your content is open for AI indexing.

findings.title: Section headings lack fragment IDs for deep linking
findings.evidence: Only 0/35 section headings (0%) across 4 page(s) have id attributes.

suggested_action.summary: Add stable id attributes to <h2> and <h3> headings to enable deep linking and AI-engine citation of specific sections. Use descriptive slugs (e.g. id='pricing-details').

proactive_recommendations: Create or link to a Wikidata entity: Wikidata is the primary knowledge base for many AI systems. A verified Wikidata entry with sameAs linking significantly improves entity recognition.
Add contactPoint to Organization schema: ContactPoint structured data helps AI engines surface your customer service details in responses.

Maintain and expand agent documentation manifest: Detected accessible AI manifest at https://www.boat-lifestyle.com/agents.md. Providing structured documentation for LLM agents significantly improves brand representation in AI search.
Add aria-label to navigation elements: 4/7 <nav> elements lack aria-label. Labelling navigation regions improves accessibility and helps AI engines understand page structure.
